div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
registerForEvent
[guards OK + capacity available]
/ insert confirmed
/ generateTicketForRegistration
/ registration_confirmation + audience sync

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
registerForEvent
[guards OK + capacity full]
/ insert waitlisted
/ waitlist notification + position
/ no ticket yet

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
promoteFirstWaitlisted
[first by registered_at + mode-filtered if hybrid]
/ status=confirmed
/ ticket + notification + email
/ trigger_waitlist_promotion

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
cancelRegistration
[previous status=confirmed]
/ frees one seat
/ may promote next waitlisted

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
cancelRegistration
/ no seat freed
/ no promotion

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
deleteRegistrationHard
[row removed + may promote]
/ registration_removed notification

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
deleteRegistrationHard
[row removed + no promotion]
/ registration_removed notification

span.p:
Entry guards: published event, deadline open,
event not ended, valid private invitation,
no active ban, no existing registration.
Hybrid capacity is per attendance_mode.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
لا توجد حالة تشغيلية "pending":
موجودة في النوع والثوابت فقط، ولا يستخدمها registerForEvent.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
لا يُبطل إلغاء التسجيل التذكرة، ولا يوجد شرط
"انتهت الفعالية". إلغاء waitlisted لا يُحرّر مقعدًا.
